study.comparator: sitagliptin 50 mg daily (DPP-4 inhibitor, decision D-X7)
study.notes: STUDY: randomised non blinded single centre trial (Dokkyo Medical University, Dokkyo J Med Sci 41(3):211-220, 2014, no DOI or registration printed) in untreated type 2 diabetes: liraglutide titrated to 0.9 mg daily within one month (dose_mg 0.9, the Japanese maximum) vs sitagliptin 50 mg daily as initial monotherapy, 6 months (26 weeks entered); 56 enrolled, 16 withdrew, 40 completed and analysed (24 liraglutide, 16 sitagliptin, Table 2 n); Table 2 gives baseline and 6 month mean plus or minus SD per arm (route arm_change_imputed_r, correlation 0.5; the Table 2 p values are within arm paired tests and a baseline comparison, not used) and medians with IQR for hsCRP and urinary albumin excretion; glycaemic control, blood pressure, body weight, lipids, endothelial function and inflammatory factors are the stated assessments (prespecified TRUE); pct_weight_change from the Table 2 means in the liraglutide arm, 82.3 to 79.3 kg, minus 3.0 kg equals minus 3.6 percent (sitagliptin 81.7 to 80.2 kg, minus 1.8 percent; no contrast printed); DPP-4 inhibitor comparator, admissibility is decision D-X7 as for LYDIA; no funding statement (industry_funded FALSE); rob_overall high

rows.notes: Table 2: HbA1c percent (NGSP) baseline and 6 months per arm; within arm p below 0.001 in both arms
Table 2: fasting glucose mg/dL baseline and 6 months per arm
Table 2: SBP mmHg baseline and 6 months per arm; within arm p below 0.01 liraglutide, 0.36 sitagliptin
Table 2: DBP mmHg baseline and 6 months per arm; within arm p below 0.01 liraglutide, 0.20 sitagliptin
Table 2: LDL-C mg/dL baseline and 6 months per arm; within arm p below 0.001 liraglutide, 0.63 sitagliptin
Table 2: triglycerides mg/dL baseline and 6 months per arm; within arm p 0.16 and 0.82
Table 2: eGFR mL per min per 1.73 m2 baseline and 6 months per arm; within arm p 0.83 and 0.33

json.design: randomised non blinded single centre trial, liraglutide 0.9 mg vs sitagliptin 50 mg as initial monotherapy in untreated type 2 diabetes, 56 enrolled, 40 completers analysed (24 and 16), 6 months
json.reason: full text group (institutional route); seven inventory markers with baseline and 6 month mean and SD per arm in Table 2 by the imputed change route; hsCRP is a median with IQR only; DPP-4 inhibitor comparator flagged for decision D-X7
biomarkers_reported_no_variance: hsCRP (Table 2 medians with IQR only: liraglutide 2.3 (0.8 to 3.3) to 0.4 (0.2 to 1.0) mg/L, within arm p below 0.01; sitagliptin 1.3 (1.0 to 2.8) to 1.2 (0.1 to 2.0), p 0.05)
other_markers: C-peptide index (CPR index, C-peptide to glucose ratio)
regression of the change in FMD on the other changes (Table 3)

rob.justification: randomised without a described sequence or concealment, unequal completer arms of 24 and 16 (D1 some concerns); non blinded with investigator discretion on titration (D2 some concerns); 16 of 56 enrolled withdrew and only the 40 completers were analysed (D3 high); laboratory assays, blood pressure measured without blinding (D4 some concerns); no registration or protocol, assessments named in the methods (D5 some concerns)

doubts: the comparator is a DPP-4 inhibitor (sitagliptin), the same admissibility question as LYDIA (decision D-X7)
29 percent withdrawal before analysis with no per arm account
no DOI or PubMed identifier printed in the packet; the journal is the Dokkyo Journal of Medical Sciences
